node.title: Re: Custom Arguements
node.author: VinsWorldcom
node.doctext:
Are you looking for a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Read%E2%80%93eval%E2%80%93print_loop|REPL]? Perl has that:

[metacpan://Devel::REPL]
[metacpan://Perl::Shell]
[metacpan://Shell::Perl]
[metacpan://perlconsole]
[metacpan://psh]

... and of course, mine:

[metacpan://App::PerlShell]

UPDATE: Example:

VinsWorldcom@C:\Users\VinsWorldcom> plsh Perl> print $Bin; Use of uninitialized value $App::PerlShell::Bin in print at (eval 19) line 2. Perl> use FindBin qw($Bin); Perl> print $Bin; C:/Users/VinsWorldcom/perl5/bin Perl>
